column3: “Everyone” limits the earth’s fullness to people.
“High place” is singular where the Hebrew has plural heights.
“Used again on a prostitute” interprets returning to a prostitute’s wages.
Jackals and ostriches are rendered in the singular.
“Wound” is singular where the Hebrew has plural wounds.
The announcement “you will give” is expressed as an instruction to send.
“In mourning” is supplied; the commands are addressed in the singular.
